business.name: Ledger Dental
business.offer: Monthly bookkeeping with cash-flow reports for independent dental clinics

north_star: I sell monthly bookkeeping with cash-flow reports to independent dental clinics in Texas with 2 to 5 dentists that just lost or outgrew their bookkeeper.

profile.label: The independent dental clinic that just outgrew its bookkeeper

requirements.name: 2 to 5 dentists under one owner
requirements.why: Enough revenue to pay for a specialist, small enough that the owner still signs the checks.

requirements.name: Independent, not part of a DSO
requirements.why: Dental service organizations have in-house finance teams; the owner-operator does not.

requirements.name: A trigger in the last 90 days
requirements.why: A bookkeeper left, a second location opened, or the CPA flagged messy books.

demographics.role: The owner dentist or the office manager
demographics.location: Texas, starting with Austin and San Antonio
demographics.stage: Established, 3 or more years in business

profile.situation_before: Books closed 6 weeks late, no idea which location makes money, tax surprises in April.
profile.situation_after: Books closed by the 10th, a one-page cash-flow report per location, no April surprises.
aspirations: Open a second location without losing control of cash
Stop doing the books on Sundays
pain_language: I only find out we lost money when my CPA calls me in March.

evidence.basis: Hypothesis: no customers yet. Chosen from four candidate segments scored on pain, purchasing power, reachability and growth, plus beachhead criteria.

niche_ladder.note: Commodity. Competes with every franchise and app on price.
Better: insurance billing makes the books complex and the pain real.

niche_ladder.level: Independent dental clinics with 2 to 5 dentists in Texas
niche_ladder.note: Reachable through the state dental association and two conferences a year.

segments_considered.name: Independent dental clinics, 2 to 5 dentists
segments_considered.note: Highest purchasing power and the clearest trigger events.

segments_considered.name: Veterinary clinics
segments_considered.note: Attractive second segment once the first ten customers are in.

segments_considered.name: Med spas
segments_considered.note: Growing fast but hard to list and highly seasonal.

anti_icp.who: Clinics owned by a DSO or private equity group
anti_icp.why: They already have a finance team and a procurement process.

anti_icp.who: Solo dentists in their first year
anti_icp.why: Not enough transactions to justify the fee; a template serves them better.

anti_icp.who: Anyone who wants tax filing only
anti_icp.why: That is a CPA engagement, not monthly bookkeeping.

watering_holes.place: Texas Dental Association meetings and the Texas Meeting in May
Dental practice brokers and lenders who see every transition
Facebook groups for dental office managers
Dental supply reps who visit 40 clinics a month

buying_path.step: A referral from a broker, lender or supply rep
buying_path.note: The trigger event usually surfaces here first.

buying_path.step: A 15-minute books check on last quarter
buying_path.note: The lead magnet that reveals the problem.

buying_path.step: A proposal with the first month free if the books are closed by the 10th
buying_path.note: Risk reversal tied to the dream outcome.

actions: Write the one-page offer with the three requirements stated up front.
List 100 clinics in Austin and San Antonio that match the profile.
Interview 10 office managers in inquiry mode: do not sell, listen for the trigger and the words they use.
Meet three practice brokers and two supply reps.
Offer the 15-minute books check to 30 clinics by email and phone.
Run 5 checks and record which trigger each one had.
Close the first 3 clients on the first-month-free offer.
Re-score the segment with real data and adjust one qualifier if needed.

next_10_customers: A 3-dentist clinic in Austin whose bookkeeper retired
A 2-location practice in San Antonio opened in 2025
A 4-dentist clinic flagged by its CPA for late books
A clinic buying a second practice through a broker
A 2-dentist clinic whose office manager does the books on weekends
A clinic switching practice management software
open_questions: Confirm the fee band with the first three proposals
Confirm whether office managers or owners answer the books check
